hard_canon: The game is about broken promises, denied witnesses and the practical work after confession.

The War of Three Crowns massacre was thirty-two years earlier: Vargan promised sanctuary; Greyfen barred its gate; shrine keepers hid the road; soldiers closed the retreat and killed those between the gates.

The White Hart freely promised concealment without bloodshed; that promise was violated. It is the sole complete supernatural witness and cannot lie, but complete recollection does not equal proportion or forgiveness.
Ghoulkin are scavenged human and animal vessels animated by incomplete denied memory; they are not complete resurrected victims or articulate revenge agents.
Halvern is a bounded memory of the sanctuary order, refusal and execution. His knowledge ends at death. Len is a repeated gate-and-lantern fragment, never a living consenting witness.
Bram Kett, Sella Vey and her twelve-year-old son Oren are the missing travelers; the opening explicitly avoids resurrecting them. They are not part of this twelve-living-NPC roster.
Recent road repairs uncovered tokens; Oren restored a name, Anwen's containment failed, and Vargan's recovery patrol arrived afterward. Do not invent a single mastermind who ordered every attack.
Anwen is46, Rook29, Senn54, Edric43. Senn was22 during the massacre. Edric suppressed the command ledger six years ago. Anwen's responsibility is present concealment, not ordering the original crime.
Food, care and safe departure cannot depend on assent. Compelled admissions may prove facts but do not supply magical consent. Documents cannot promise for people.
Four endings remain reachable with main-path records and the protagonist's voluntary responsibility: Witness, Mercy, Duty and Ash. Optional people share burdens, not ending unlock keys.

The current source calls the protagonist Kael, age38. The user's newer master prompt says Kyle. The pack avoids changing or depicting the player; implementation must resolve the established naming decision without silently renaming identifiers.
Senn may be in custody, exiled or executed. Proposed forward scenes must respect those states and never resurrect him for convenience.

monster_notes: Bell-Eater: cemetery, consumes buried names, bell shockwave from graves, silence interrupts summons, phases chain sweep / grave slam / ghoulkin call.
Rootbound: memory clearing, readable root lanes with central gap, rupture exposes heart, soil fed by refugee ash.
Ashwing is explicitly a carrion DRAKE, nests above the ash-fed mill, directional wing pressure and ash breath, broken perch exposes it.
Bog Wretch guards the last frightened fragment absorbed by the marsh; ash exposes its memory core.
Stalker flanks and remembers traps; Raider feints toward bodies then lunges for tokens; Brute arrives last and breaks a route rather than pursuing indefinitely.
Visual review of current spectral monster derivatives remains pending in the source manifests; an inclusion authorization is not final visual approval.
